name: Cyber Clinic Junior Member Program
org: Cyber Clinic (listed by UNLV Early Outreach)
what_you_do: Join a cybersecurity group as a junior member. You can go to meetings and work on Cyber Clinic projects. You can also join certificate training and career skills sessions.
who_can_apply: Students in the ninth grade and above can join as Junior Members.
pay_detail: Cost and pay are not stated on the program page. UNLV's youth page lists it as no cost.
duration: Not stated on the program page. UNLV's youth page says weekly online workshops.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now button on the program page. It links to jmprogram@cyberclinicofficial.org. Questions go to the same email.
notes: UNLV Early Outreach lists this program for high school students with weekly online workshops at no cost. The program page itself does not state the schedule, so ask before you plan around it.
